candidates.name: Malignant Mesothelioma
support_spans: Epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures
Immunoreactive for calretinin, AE1/AE3, D2-40, Wilms tumor protein 1
Neoplastic cells immunoreactive for calretinin, confirming mesothelial origin
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with pleural thickenings and effusion, along with the pathological findings of epithelioid cells and immunoreactivity for mesothelial markers, supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Metastatic Malignant Mesothelioma
support_spans: Nodular growth observed on the mid third of the tongue
Neoplastic subepithelial proliferation, consisting of epithelioid cells in the tongue
candidates.why: The appearance of a nodular growth on the tongue with similar pathological features to the primary pleural disease suggests metastasis.
